description: Undo the agent's own most recent draw_on_board call — same ownership rule as the human "Undo my last stroke": only the caller's strokes are removed, never other participants'. One call = one batch (e.g. an arrow is one batch of 3 strokes). `count` undoes multiple previous batches (1-10). Broadcasts board-remove so connected clients drop those ids; get_board_state stops returning them.

agentSecret.description: Optional agent credential (8-128 chars). Must match the secret that claimed this senderId. REQUIRED on a locked pond.

count.description: How many of the agent's previous draw calls (batches) to undo. Default 1, max 10.

roomId.description: The room ID whose board to edit.

senderId.description: The agent identity whose strokes to undo (must match the senderId used in draw_on_board). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

name: undo_board
title: Undo board strokes
